features: Sold as a family of 4 SKUs: E4U-4RV(2.8) AI, E4U-4RV(4) AI, E4U-4RVS(2.8) AI (two-way audio), E4U-4RVS(4) AI (two-way audio)
Fixed-iris lens, offered in 2.8mm or 4mm focal length variants
DWDR, 3D noise reduction, backlight compensation, automatic white balance, defog
Dual stream (main + sub), VBR/CBR bit rate control
AI with 1T computing power: human and vehicle detection
Motion detection, intrusion detection, tripwire detection, off-duty detection, passenger flow statistics
Remote monitoring via HOLOZ VMS / HOLOZ App mobile client
release_notes: This datasheet covers a family of 4 SKUs sharing one spec sheet: focal length is either 2.8mm or 4mm (fixed, not varifocal), and built-in two-way audio (speaker) is present only on the 'S' variants (E4U-4RVS...); the base E4U-4RV variants have microphone only, no speaker. The target model name combines all variants as E4U-4RV(S)(2.8)(4) AI.
